Name: Sleepy - Animated Sword
Author: SleepyDav
Description:
[line]
[b]Sleepy – Animated Sword Pack[/b] adds stylish [b]animated weapon effects[/b] to Stardew Valley, bringing life and personality to two legendary weapons: [b]Galaxy Sword[/b] and [b]Infinity Blade[/b].

Each weapon features multiple animation styles that can be switched easily through [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM), [/b]no manual file editing required.

Designed for [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b], this mod uses [b]SpaceCore TextureOverrides[/b] to deliver smooth, immersive weapon animations.

[line]
Galaxy Sword (Available Now)The Galaxy Sword comes with [b]4 animated styles[/b], selectable via [b]GMCM[/b] using number-based options:
[list=1]
[*][b]Glowing Animation[/b] [i](Default)[/i]
A soft, elegant glow that enhances the Galaxy Sword’s mystical aura.
[*][b]Thunder Animation[/b]
Electric energy flows through the blade with a powerful lightning effect.
[*][b]Fire Animation[/b]
A blazing fire animation that gives the sword a fierce and aggressive look.
[*][b]Shining Animation[/b]
A clean, radiant shining effect for a polished and heroic appearance.[/list][line]
Infinity Blade (Included)The Infinity Blade features [b]4 animated effects[/b], selectable via [b]GMCM[/b] using number-based options:
[list=1]
[*][b]Infinity_Charge[/b]
A charging energy animation that builds power over time.
[*][b]Infinity_Burst[/b]
A fully charged animation with a dramatic explosive effect.
[*][b]Blood_Circle[/b]
A circular energy effect that expands outward and bursts.
[*][b]Infinity_Shining[/b]
A clean and elegant shining animation, similar to the Galaxy Sword’s shining style.
[/list][line]
[list]
[*]Animation styles can be changed via [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b]
[*]Options use [b]number-based selection (1–4)[/b] for simplicity
[*]Changes apply instantly without restarting the game
[/list][line]
Requirements[b]Required:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] (latest version)
[*][b]Content Patcher[/b]
[*][b]SpaceCore[/b]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b]
[/list][b]
Optional (Recommended):[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b]
[i](Allows in-game configuration without editing config files)[/i][/list][line]
⚠️ Important Notes[list]
[*]This mod relies on [b]SpaceCore TextureOverrides[/b] for animated weapons.
[*]Without [b]SpaceCore[/b], the weapons will not animate correctly.
[*]Compatible with other weapon mods that do not overwrite the same tilesheet area.
[/list][line]
📌 Installation[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b]
[*]Install [b]Content Patcher[/b]
[*]Install [b]SpaceCore[/b]
[*](Optional) Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b]
[*]Extract this mod into your [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code] folder
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI

[/list][line]
🛠️ Compatibility[list]
[*]Stardew Valley [b]1.6+[/b]
[*]Single-player & multiplayer compatible
[*]Safe to add or remove (visual-only mod)
[/list][list]
[/list][line]
Created by[b] Dava[/b]
